purpose: One stable boot for fresh or parallel agents. Runtime compiles the smallest current work context so agents spend effort on product reasoning instead of repository archaeology.

hard_commands.Prometeo: RESYNC + RECOVER + CONTINUE: infer the current/previous unfinished intent, prefer one active compiled packet; otherwise route through a Catalog surface card + GENERAL packet; reconcile only new deltas; choose the execution profile; continue; print the Prometeo Seal only after successful load.
Continue the active packet execution frontier without regenerating settled context, title maps or specifications.

seal.human_rule: If a response that should be operating under Prometeo has no violet seal, the user may send only `Prometeo` to force resync/recovery.

legacy_chat_rule: For an already-open chat that has never learned the Prometeo trigger, send the chat_bootstrap URL once. After that, `Prometeo` alone is the recovery command.
fallback: If compiled runtime is unavailable, fall back to NOW/PACK/LAST_RETURN/delta routing. Do not ask the human to reconstruct context until durable recovery paths have failed.
truth: Entry/runtime coordinate agents only; GENERAL does not grant write authority; none of these grant Current, Served, publication or Human-Acceptance authority.
